items.title: List running services
items.content:
Get-Service | Where-Object Status -eq 'Running' |
    Sort-Object DisplayName | Select-Object Name, DisplayName

items.title: Free disk space
items.content:
Get-PSDrive -PSProvider FileSystem |
    Select-Object Name, @{ n = 'Free (GB)'; e = { [math]::Round($_.Free / 1GB, 1) } }
